svg.title: Within-month model variability across2024
svg.desc: Population standard deviations of total and low-pass hourly eastward velocity, northward velocity and salinity. Each row represents a complete calendar month. These describe serially dependent model temporal variation, not confidence intervals, measurement uncertainty or physical current-width ranges. Missing support remains gray. Numeric statistics and all hourly section fields accompany this figure.
